title: An online soft sensor based on adaptive double Gaussian Bayesian network
journal_or_publisher: Chemometrics and Intelligent Laboratory Systems / Elsevier
authors: Haoyan Dong; Jintao Shi; Lei Chen; Kuangrong Hao
reliability_note: Publisher abstract, introduction, method snippet, and conclusion were checked. The proposed system updates an auxiliary calibration model incrementally; it is therefore evidence for a frozen/offline predictor plus adaptive correction-layer architecture, not for a completely parameter-free correction scheme.
